1999.o: Swamishri performs murti pratishtha at Shree Swaminarayan Mandir, Kailashpuri, More than 3000 devotees participated
w: 2 Dec. 99: (V.S. 2056, Kartak Vad 10 Thursday Swamishri performs murti pratishtha in the newly completed Shree Swaminarayan Mandir, Mahudha
Swamishri performs murti pratishtha in the newly constructed Shree Swaminarayan Mandir, Padgol. More than 10,000 devotees and well-wishers participated.
ph: With young performers of the welcome dance

w: Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored prior to Swamishri's morning puja.

This morning, Swamishri arrived for the World Peace Yagna at the Swaminarayan Nagar. 1,460 devotees participated in the yagna by offering rice grains and ghee into 165 sanctified fires. The main stage of the yagna comprised of murtis for ten new mandirs in the Kheda district. Swamishri worshipped them with chandan, rice grains and flowers. After the yagna rituals an assembly was held on the festival ground.

In the afternoon, from 3.00 pm to 7.00 pm a grand procession of the murtis to be consecrated at the newly built Swaminarayan Mandir, Anand and the nine mandirs in Kheda district was carried out. The 6km long route carried the procession through the streets of Vidyanagar and Anand. The procession concluded at the newly built mandir in Anand. The enthusiasm of the devotees and sadhus peaked on seeing Swamishri bless the procession from the mandir balcony. ( see special report )

At 10.00 am Swamishri arrived at Dharmaj from Bochasan to bless the Silver Jubilee anniversary of the inauguration of the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir (hari mandir patotsav). After performing the pujan and arti rituals of the murtis, Swamishri blessed the assembly, "Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj has visited Dharmaj on many occasions. Today we find that science has enabled man to progress immensely but there has also been a rise in problems and unrest inour world. To dissolve this darkness of ignorance we have had the divine incarnations of God and great sadhus. Bhagwan Swaminarayan gave the wonderful Shikshapatri as a moral, social and spiritual manual for mankind..." In conclusion to the assembly, Shri Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees.

At 5.00 pm Swamishri departed from Delhi by air and arrived at Kolkata at 6.48 pm. After darshan of Thakorji at the BAPS Mandir Swamishri was welcomed by the BAPS youth band while going to the welcome assembly arranged nearby. The youth performed a welcome dance and after the garlanding ceremony Swamishri blessed the assembly. Through technology you were able to have darshan of Akshardham. Technology is an art of God. Through his inspiration it came to be invented. That is all part of progress, but through Satsang and bhakti one is rid of inner vices and ignorance…”
For some days Pramukh Swami Maharaj's health had been weak, so he did his morning puja in his room and mostly stayed in his room doing letter reading and other activities.

Today too, during the meal, Swamishri ate khichdi and yoghurt, and that too in a smaller quantity than usual. At first Swamishri was alone in the room. Swamishri expressed a wish: "Let some scripture be read." So Akhanddarshan Swami was called. He read from "Swaminarayan Prakash". Swamishri's meal finished quickly, but Swamishri's hunger for katha was not satisfied, so he commanded that the reading continue. For about two hours straight Swamishri listened to "Swaminarayan Prakash" in this way. Swamishri has never been satisfied with katha and spiritual talks.

Today, during the midday meal, the sadhus looking after the cultural department of Pramukh Swami Maharaj's birthday celebration said, "Good children were selected and sent to Mumbai for more practice."
Hearing this, Mahant Swami Maharaj at once asked, "What about their school?"
"They were sent during the Diwali vacation."
"Then that's fine." Saying this, Swamishri nodded his head in satisfaction.
Swamishri has always been an advocate of balanced development. He does not like seva and satsang at the cost of education.
